summary.route_principle: Prefer complete speeches, accusations with consequences, recollections with appeals, and judgment-restoration diptychs. Famous later-reused verses remain hydrated inside Hosea's own larger movements.
summary.premortem_center: The likeliest failure is proof-text atomization amplified by English chaptering, later citation, and interpretive punctuation at 1:10-2:1, 6:11-7:2, 11:12-12:1, and 13:14-14:1.

global_guards: Later reuse may establish a later text's reuse of Hosea but may not force Hosea's boundary, speaker, meaning, chronology, or fulfillment.
Editorial cross-references are navigation metadata, not automatic graph or retrieval truth.
OSHB morphology and lemma attributes are metadata aids; roots, morphology, and Strong-style hints are not meanings or boundary authority.

No relation below establishes literary dependence, direction of borrowing, authorship, date, fulfillment, or theological identity unless the later WEB text explicitly names Hosea, and even then only the later reuse is observed.
Marriage, prostitution, sexual, infant, pregnancy, and warfare imagery must never be detached from accusation, lament, judgment, or restoration context for devotional retrieval.
Ambiguous speakers and pronouns remain ambiguous; no wife, child, king, prophet, Adam, Assyria, Egypt, Death, or Sheol identity is forced.
The local canonical inventory governs coordinates. Alternate Hebrew, Greek, or English numbering is recorded only as a crosswalk hazard.
Disputed child seams collapse upward to a named macro parent with reduced confidence.

versification_and_coordinate_hazards.risk: English and Hebrew traditions may number the naming-reversal lines differently; a chapter boundary can sever the three-name reversal.
versification_and_coordinate_hazards.countermeasure: Use local OSIS coordinates, keep the cross-chapter parent, and require explicit external crosswalk review before exporting alternate numbering.

versification_and_coordinate_hazards.risk: English punctuation and chaptering may conceal whether restoration, healing, and exposed iniquity form one transition or two.
versification_and_coordinate_hazards.countermeasure: Hold the exact child seam and retrieve the cross-chapter transition as one parent.

versification_and_coordinate_hazards.risk: Hebrew/English numbering offset and rapid Judah/Ephraim speech movement can misattach Hos.11.12.
versification_and_coordinate_hazards.countermeasure: Keep the two local verses together as the candidate bridge, but retain an explicit two-option hold.

versification_and_coordinate_hazards.risk: Interpretive punctuation at Death/Sheol and alternate numbering around the Samaria/return transition can create a false promise-only unit.
versification_and_coordinate_hazards.countermeasure: Hydrate Hos.13.14 through the whole Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16 parent and treat Hos.13.16-Hos.14.1 as a local-coordinate hard seam pending crosswalk verification.

macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Attach to any book-level Hosea retrieval; never use the king list to settle date, authorship, or the chronology of every oracle.
Children may surface individual naming speeches, but all names and their reversals must hydrate together.
Sexualized accusation, exposure, and deprivation language requires the whole lawsuit-restoration parent and an ethics warning.
Keep action and interpretation together; do not settle the woman's identity or turn the sign into marriage advice.
Hydrate accusations with addressees and consequences; preserve rapid priest, people, Ephraim, Israel, and Judah shifts.
Return/healing language must retain the divine reply and failed-return outcome.
Calf, harvest, king, Gibeah, and mountain sayings remain within the cult-monarchy judgment movement.
Hos.11.1 must hydrate through compassion and return; Matthew's reuse cannot shrink this parent.
Jacob and exodus-prophet allusions require their accusation-to-appeal-to-verdict sequence.
Hos.13.14 is never a stand-alone promise object; hydrate through stored guilt, birth pangs, Death/Sheol, east wind, and the closing violence warning.
Retrieve the petition, divine answer, flourishing poem, and wisdom colophon as a concluding movement.

macro_hydration_recommendations.reason: Later reuse of the people/not-people language can obscure the enacted names, accusation, and restoration sequence.
Mercy-not-sacrifice belongs inside a failed-return exchange and divine reply, not a free-standing cult rule.
The mountains saying is the climax of the calf/high-place judgment, not an isolated apocalyptic slogan.
The son/Egypt recollection advances through refusal, threatened judgment, compassion, and return.
Later reuse and English punctuation can suppress the unresolved rhetorical direction and immediate judgment context.
The wisdom close evaluates the whole return/healing movement and should not be detached.

ranked_hard_boundary_docket.reason: The enacted sign interpretation ends and a formal land lawsuit begins with a new hearing summons.
Samaria's violent judgment closes before a direct return summons, although alternate numbering must be crosswalked.
Battle and king judgment reset to first-person parental recollection.
Political indictment closes and a fresh trumpet command opens.
Fire judgment closes before a new direct prohibition of festival rejoicing.
Failed seeking/new-moon judgment resets to an alarm sequence naming new locations.
Divine withdrawal closes and an unattributed communal return speech begins.
The communal return appeal is answered by direct divine questions to Ephraim and Judah.
Threat and refusal pivot into a four-question compassion reversal.
Jacob/prophet recollection and repayment close before a new compressed Ephraim/Baal history.
Prophetic first-person rejection verdict resets to a luxuriant-vine accusation.
The third judgment name pivots to a coordinated reversal, but the enacted-sign parent remains mandatory.
Visit/judgment language pivots on 'therefore' into wilderness allurement and restoration.
The restoration response closes before a third-person wisdom colophon.
Divine memory and engulfing deeds shift into a court/oven conspiracy portrait.

ranked_failure_modes.countermeasure: Mandatory macro hydration and a later-reuse guard on every relation.

ranked_failure_modes.premortem: An alternate numbering scheme silently drops, duplicates, or reassigns a local verse.
ranked_failure_modes.countermeasure: Local OSIS is authoritative for this route; alternate numbering requires an explicit independently reviewed crosswalk.

ranked_failure_modes.countermeasure: Retain diptych parents and bidirectional neighbor hydration.

ranked_failure_modes.countermeasure: Ethics warning, whole-parent retrieval, ambiguous identities preserved, and human review for downstream pastoral use.

genuine_contested_questions.question: Should the naming reversal remain one cross-chapter child?

option_a.argument: The sand promise, united children, Jezreel reversal, and commands to say 'My people/My loved one' complete the three-name reversal.

option_b.argument: The direct command in Hos.2.1 may open the following marital lawsuit in some numbering and discourse analyses.

genuine_contested_questions.why_needed: Alternate numbering evidence was not supplied.

genuine_contested_questions.question: Where should the harvest/restore/heal transition attach?

option_a.position: Keep Hos.6.11-Hos.7.2 as a cross-chapter child.
option_a.argument: Restoring fortunes, attempted healing, exposed iniquity, and remembered deeds form a coherent frustrated-restoration transition.

option_b.position: Attach Hos.6.11 to Hos.6.8-Hos.6.10 and begin Hos.7.1-Hos.7.2 separately.
option_b.argument: Judah's harvest may close the prior geographic indictment, while 'When I would heal' begins a new Samaria accusation.

genuine_contested_questions.why_needed: English punctuation is insufficient to resolve the Hebrew transition.

genuine_contested_questions.question: Does Hos.11.12 bridge into Hos.12.1 or close Hos.11?

option_a.argument: Falsehood, deceit, wind, lies, desolation, and Assyria/Egypt alliances form a compact Ephraim indictment.

option_b.position: Attach Hos.11.12 to Hos.11.8-Hos.11.11 and Hos.12.1 to Hos.12.2-Hos.12.6.
option_b.argument: Judah's clause and alternate numbering can associate Hos.11.12 with the preceding speech, while Hos.12.1 may open the controversy.

genuine_contested_questions.why_needed: The supplied packet lacks an independently verified versification/syntax crosswalk.

genuine_contested_questions.question: May a child seam follow the Death/Sheol address?

option_a.position: Use Hos.13.12-Hos.13.14 and Hos.13.15-Hos.13.16 as held children.
option_a.argument: Stored guilt, birth pangs, and Death/Sheol form one rhetorical cluster; east wind and Samaria then specify the judgment.

option_b.position: Keep Hos.13.12-Hos.13.16 as one unsplit unit.
option_b.argument: The direction of Hos.13.14 and 'compassion hidden' may flow directly into east-wind and Samaria judgment, making the seam interpretively dangerous.

genuine_contested_questions.why_needed: Later reuse cannot adjudicate the Hebrew questions or punctuation.

genuine_contested_questions.question: Can the strong local literary seam be exported safely across numbering systems?

option_a.position: Treat the local Hos.13.16|Hos.14.1 seam as hard.
option_a.argument: The WEB inventory clearly ends Samaria's violence before the direct 'Israel, return' summons.

option_b.position: Represent a larger crosswalk parent spanning the alternate Hos.14.1 numbering.
option_b.argument: Some Hebrew/English numbering systems locate the Samaria line differently, so a portable address may otherwise mispoint.

genuine_contested_questions.why_needed: A portable alternate-numbering table is absent.

genuine_contested_questions.question: What ambiguity note should accompany WEB's 'like Adam'?

option_a.position: Personal Adam/covenant comparison remains a possible reading.
option_a.argument: WEB explicitly prints 'like Adam,' and Genesis supplies the canonical personal name.

option_b.position: Place-name or broader human comparison remains possible.
option_b.argument: Adam is also a canonical place-name, and the pinned manifests do not choose the syntax or referent.

genuine_contested_questions.why_needed: This affects annotation, not the recommended Hos.6.4-Hos.6.7 boundary.

genuine_contested_questions.question: How should the lips/bulls/offering wording be represented?

option_a.position: Retain WEB's 'bulls as we vowed of our lips' exactly as translation witness.
option_a.argument: It is the pinned local wording and must not be silently normalized.

option_b.position: Add a non-preferred alternate-rendering note after source review.
option_b.argument: The difficult wording is well known to affect how verbal praise and sacrificial imagery are related, but no alternate witness is pinned here.

genuine_contested_questions.why_needed: This affects display and annotation, not the Hos.14.1-Hos.14.3 unit.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Court wickedness and oven conspiracy
unit_reviews.failure_mode: The oven image is split or mapped to one speculative coup.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep the complete simile and mark court chronology unresolved.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Mixed Ephraim, unturned cake, consumed strength, and no return
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Cake or gray-hair images become independent aphorisms.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Hydrate all three verses and the failed-return macro.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Dove, Egypt-Assyria, net, false cry, and faulty bow
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Egypt/Assyria references are tied to one unverified treaty or the dove is moralized alone.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Retain political and worship accusations together; chronology unresolved.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Trumpet, breached covenant, rejected good, unauthorized kings, and calf
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Exodus and Kings parallels collapse distinct calf episodes or settle the identity of each king.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Use canonical background cards only and preserve the whole indictment.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Sowing wind, swallowed Israel, wandering ally-seeking, and wasting
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Difficult Hos.8.10 wording selects a preferred translation or gathering is made automatically restorative.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Lower confidence and keep all four verses under the judgment movement.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Altars, estranged law, rejected offerings, Egypt, and fire
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Return to Egypt is read as one literal event or Judah/Israel are split into separate oracles.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep shared forgetting/consequence progression and evidence-only Deuteronomy relation.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Forbidden rejoicing, failed produce, exile food, and impossible feast
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Egypt, Memphis, Assyria, and feast practice are over-historicized.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Mark historical setting unresolved; keep festival-to-exile logic intact.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Visitation, rejected prophet, snare, and Gibeah memory
unit_reviews.failure_mode: The prophet's identity is forced or Gibeah is reduced to one decontextualized violent verse.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Speaker/prophet ambiguity plus whole Judges context and content warning.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Wilderness grapes, Baal Peor, vanished fertility, and anguished petition
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Reproductive violence is isolated, or Baal Peor becomes a generalized sexual accusation.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Whole lament, ethics warning, and full Numbers episode hydration.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Gilgal expulsion, dried root, bereavement, and wandering
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Hos.9.17's 'My God' speaker shift is used to sever the verdict or settle prophet identity.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Record speaker shift but keep the fruit/birth/wandering conclusion intact.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Luxuriant vine, divided heart, powerless king, calf exile, and fallen high places
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Later reuse splits Hos.10.8 from the high-place/calf climax or imposes one apocalypse.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Mandatory HOS-U031/HOS-MACRO-07 hydration before Luke or Revelation.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Gibeah recurrence and gathered chastisement
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Difficult Hos.10.10 wording is solved by a preferred translation or Judges violence is flattened.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Lower confidence, preserve pair, whole Judges context.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Heifer, plowing, righteous sowing, wicked harvest, battle, and destroyed king
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Hos.10.12 becomes a positive aphorism while Beth Arbel and mother-child violence are detached.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep exhortation, failure, and consequence together with violence/history flags.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Loved child, exodus call, rejected teaching, and cords of love
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Matthew forces Hos.11.1 into a stand-alone prediction or pronoun difficulty forces a seam.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep parental recollection intact and later reuse subordinate.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Refused return, Assyrian rule, sword, and bent-away people
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Egypt/Assyria alternatives or difficult pronouns are harmonized into one chronology.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Preserve WEB wording and mark political/textual reconstruction unavailable.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Compassion reversal, Holy One, lion roar, and returning children
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Compassion is separated from judgment or the roar is harmonized with Amos/Joel into one event.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep the entire reversal and non-directional Twelve cluster.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Ephraim falsehood, Judah ambiguity, wind, lies, and foreign covenants
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Versification or a preferred Judah reading misattaches the bridge.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Collapse to HOS-MACRO-09 until crosswalk/syntax review.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Controversy with Jacob, heel and struggle memories, Bethel, and appeal
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Each Genesis allusion becomes a child or angel/divine identity is forced.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep compression and concluding appeal as one unit.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Dishonest scales, wealth claim, exodus God, tents, prophets, and worthless altars
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Merchant/Canaan translation is decided or tents/feast is isolated as a promise.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep WEB wording, lower confidence, and retain the accusation-response movement.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Jacob's service, prophet-mediated exodus, and Ephraim's repayment
unit_reviews.failure_mode: The prophet is over-identified or Genesis and Exodus memories are severed from the verdict.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep all three verses and relation claims descriptive.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Ephraim's exaltation, Baal guilt, multiplying idols, and vanishing images
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Hos.13.1's difficult wording or human-sacrifice phrase is settled without source review.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Lower confidence and avoid an identity or historical-practice label.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Exodus God, wilderness knowledge, forgetting, and predatory animals
unit_reviews.failure_mode: No-savior language becomes a detached systematic proposition or animal violence a stand-alone image.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep covenant-memory-to-consequence sequence.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Destroyed helper, absent king, demanded princes, and angry monarchy
unit_reviews.failure_mode: One king is identified or Samuel is used to condemn every monarchy without nuance.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Use monarchy background as evidence and preserve Hosea's questions.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Stored guilt, failed birth, and Death/Sheol address
unit_reviews.failure_mode: 1 Corinthians and English punctuation force a promise-only reading and child.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Hydrate HOS-U044/HOS-U045/HOS-MACRO-10 and preserve punctuation ambiguity.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: East wind, dried springs, plunder, and Samaria's violence
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Graphic violence is detached, or alternate numbering misaddresses the Samaria verse.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Violence warning, mandatory macro, and verified crosswalk before export.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Return summons and prepared words of confession
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Lips/bulls wording is normalized or the prayer is detached from renounced Assyria/horses/idols.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Preserve WEB wording, keep all three verses, and defer alternates to source review.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Healing, free love, dew, flourishing, shade, and abandoned idols
unit_reviews.failure_mode: Dew, lily, Lebanon, olive, grain, vine, or cypress becomes an isolated prosperity promise.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Keep the complete divine answer and final idol question.

unit_reviews.proposal_title: Wisdom colophon: right ways and divergent walkers
unit_reviews.failure_mode: The colophon is detached from the return/healing movement or used to settle redaction/authorship.
unit_reviews.countermeasure: Hydrate HOS-U046/HOS-U047 and record form without authorship inference.

validation.coverage_algorithm: Expand every proposed inclusive OSIS span against the canonical inventory; require each canonical verse exactly once, no extras, ordered adjacency, and positive contiguous unit indices.
